title: FairTranslate: An English-French Dataset for Gender Bias Evaluation in Machine Translation by Overcoming Gender Binarity

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates English-to-French translation performance (using BLEU and COMET metrics) on a custom dataset (FairTranslate) containing sentences with male, female, and inclusive (non-binary) gender markers. It specifically analyzes how models handle occupational nouns and pronouns like the singular 'they' and whether they correctly generate inclusive French forms.

The authors categorize occupations in their dataset as male-stereotyped, female-stereotyped, or gender-balanced based on statistical data. They analyze translation errors to determine if models default to gendered forms based on these stereotypes (e.g., assuming 'nurse' is female) rather than the explicit or implicit gender indicators in the source text.
